title: Itô maps for any-step SDEs
claim: Steering a stochastic sampler with a cheap learned map yields reward-improved, diverse samples from the same shared noise path.
layout: Noise image left, colored Brownian paths branching to a 4x5 image grid
description: The left side shows a noisy initial image labeled x_0. Four jagged Brownian paths in green, orange and purple fan out from it to the right. Each path ends at a row of generated images. The first two rows are green and show steam locomotives, the third is orange and shows a volcano, and the fourth is purple and shows a geyser. The columns are labeled SDE, BEL, Itô-GF, Itô-G and BEL-I. The plain SDE column is the baseline. The steered methods in the other columns give more vivid, higher-reward images, with brighter colors, erupting lava and taller steam plumes. The eye goes first to the colorful photo grid. The paths then show that each row shares one Brownian trajectory.
caption: Inference-time steering with ImageReward. Prompt for top 2 rows: a steam locomotive with steam billowing; for the third row: a volcano erupting with magma; for the fourth row: a geyser erupting with a towering steam plume. Each row uses a single shared Brownian trajectory.
abstract: Recent one-step generative models accelerate sampling by learning deterministic flow maps of the underlying dynamics. These methods rely on learning from ordinary differential equations, leaving open how to define an exact distillation procedure for stochastic dynamics. We introduce the ItÃ´ map, an any-step stochastic flow map that takes an intermediate state and Brownian path and predicts future states in a single pass. The ItÃ´ map formulation yields novel estimators for inference-time control by providing cheap, differentiable access to posterior samples. Empirically, ItÃ´ maps produce diverse, conditionally valid endpoint samples from fixed intermediate states and support strong steering performance on synthetic and image-generation benchmarks. These results establish any-step SDE integration as a useful primitive for posterior sampling and stochastic control.
